bread_mix.front: BANANA BREAD MIX Makes 1 loaf · 10 slices NET WT 14 OZ (397 g)
bread_mix.side: BEST BY JAN 18 2028 YOU WILL NEED 2 eggs · 1/3 cup oil · 2/3 cup water DIRECTIONS 1. Heat oven to 350°F. Grease the bottom of an 8 x 4 inch loaf pan. 2. Stir mix, water, oil and eggs until blended. 3. Pour into the pan. 4. Bake 45 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. 5. Cool 10 minutes before slicing. Nutrition Facts 10 servings per container Serving size 1/10 package (40g) Calories 150 Total Fat 1g 1% Sodium 220mg 10% Total Carb. 33g 12% INGREDIENTS ENRICHED FLOUR, SUGAR, DRIED BANANA, LEAVENING (BAKING SODA), SALT, NATURAL FLAVOR. CONTAINS: WHEAT.

sleep_aid.front: SLEEP AID Diphenhydramine HCl 25 mg Nighttime Sleep-Aid 24 CAPLETS
sleep_aid.side: EXP 05/2027  LOT 3K0921 Drug Facts Active ingredient (in each caplet) Purpose Diphenhydramine HCl 25 mg Nighttime sleep-aid Use for relief of occasional sleeplessness Warnings Do not use for children under 12 years of age; with any other product containing diphenhydramine. When using this product avoid alcoholic drinks. Stop use and ask a doctor if sleeplessness lasts more than 2 weeks. Keep out of reach of children. Directions adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets at bedtime if needed, or as directed by a doctor. children under 12 years: do not use. Other information store at 20-25°C (68-77°F)

pain_relief.front: PAIN RELIEF Extra Strength Acetaminophen 500 mg Pain Reliever / Fever Reducer 100 CAPLETS
pain_relief.side: EXP 10/2027  LOT 5P2207 Drug Facts Active ingredient (in each caplet) Purpose Acetaminophen 500 mg Pain reliever/fever reducer Uses temporarily relieves minor aches and pains; temporarily reduces fever Warnings Liver warning: severe liver damage may occur if you take more than 4,000 mg in 24 hours, with other drugs containing acetaminophen, or 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day. Keep out of reach of children. Directions adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last. Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours. children under 12 years: ask a doctor.
